title: Generate unit tests for a pure utility function
prompt: Write thorough unit tests for src/util/slugify.ts using bun:test. Save them at tests/util/slugify.test.ts and run them.

files.content:
export const slugify = (input: string): string =>
  input
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-]/g, "")
    .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
    .replace(/-+/g, "-")

rubric.description: Tests cover a normal string → expected slug case.
Tests cover empty string, leading/trailing whitespace, special chars, and consecutive spaces.
Tests import `describe`/`test`/`expect` from `bun:test` (the project test runner).
Agent executes the tests and reports they pass.
